snippet.title: IverianWars Gameplay#IverianWars,#Trailer,#MMORPG
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1191830/Iverian_Wars_Craxion_vs_Defugel/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=videos&utm_campaign=game_play&utm_content=Territory_War

In the world of Iveria, a powerful empire has collapsed, and in its place have risen two divided and troubled empires. What was once a peaceful continent is now torn apart by war between the two most powerful factions, Craxion and Defugel.

War is everywhere. Small and large battles erupt in every corner of the continent. Yet the roots of this conflict trace back to the ancient era of the Iverian Empire. It is only a matter of time before the two greatest factions must unite and stand together to confront the darkest scheme of all.

Will the continent survive at all?

Join us in Iverian Wars: Craxion vs Defugel at the most exciting moment in the history of Iveria—and stop the continent from falling.
